brief.zh: 把维修台的电池从低电量排到高电量。每轮在待排序区逐块比较，找出最小的一块，把它换到待排序区的第一格。
brief.en: Arrange the repair bench batteries from lowest to highest charge. In each round, scan the unsorted section, then swap its lowest-charge battery into the first unsorted slot.

concept.zh: 寻找最小值、交换位置、扩大已排好范围
concept.en: Find the minimum, swap positions, and grow the sorted section

body.zh: 先把待排序区的第一块当作最小候选。每比一块，只有它的电量更低时才换候选。
body.en: Start with the first unsorted battery as your candidate. Change the candidate only when you find a lower charge.

body.zh: 把这一轮选中的电池换到待排序区的第一格。如果它已经在这一格，直接固定。只剩一块时，它已经在最后一格。
body.en: Swap the selected battery into the first unsorted slot. If it is already there, settle the slot as it is. The one remaining battery is already in the last slot.

prompt.zh: 一轮比较结束后，发现最小的电池就在待排序区的第一格。接下来怎么做？
prompt.en: A round ends with the lowest-charge battery already in the first unsorted slot. What happens next?

options.zh: 跟待排序区的最后一格交换
options.en: Swap with the last unsorted slot

feedback.zh: 它已经在正确的位置，这一轮可以直接固定它。
feedback.en: It is already in the right place, so this round can settle it as it is.
